articles.title: ‘Beef’ Actor Justin H. Min’s ‘Journey There,’ Hong Sangsoo’s Locarno Winner ‘Nowhere to Lay My Eyes’ Rack Up International Sales for Finecut
articles.summary: Hong Sangsoo’s “Nowhere to Lay My Eyes,” a triple prizewinner at the 79th Locarno Film Festival, and Kim Jin-yu’s “Journey There,” the first Korean production to star “Beef” actor Justin H. Min, have picked up a new batch of territory deals through Seoul-based sales outfit Finecut.
body: The film is Hong’s 35th feature. At Locarno it won best direction, best performance and the Ecumenical Jury Prize. It sees the director team up again with regulars Kim Minhee (“By the Stream”) and Kwon Haehyo (“What Does That Nature Say to You”), and marks his first outing with Choi Myeonggil, whose credits include TV series “Durian’s Affair.” Jeonwonsa Film Co. produced.

“Journey There” has sold to Andrews Film for Taiwan, KDDI Corporation for Japan, Lev Cinema for Israel and Izagur Media for Mongolia, while Kairos Distribution acquired inflight rights. The drama centers on a middle-aged widow who begins getting ready for her own journey and gets drawn into relationships she never saw coming in the apartment she has just moved into.

Min’s credits include Kogonada’s “After Yang” and the Netflix series “Beef” and “The Umbrella Academy.” The film is the second feature from Kim, whose first, “Bori,” took two prizes at the 24th Schlingel International Film Festival. Kim’s own company, Pado, produced.

articles.title: Ian McKellen Pays Tribute to Close Friend Patrick Stewart: ‘He Wore His Heart on His Sleeve’
articles.summary: Ian McKellen wrote a moving tribute to Patrick Stewart, his close friend of many years, following his death Thursday at age 86 after suffering from Alzheimer’s and Lewy Body Dementia.
body: “America was his adopted home, where he met his adored Sunny who has cared for him through sickness and health, through thick and thin. But he never forsook his origins: and the proudest achievement of the most respected and beloved actor of his generation on either side of the Atlantic, was his appointment as Chancellor of Huddersfield University in Yorkshire.”
“His farewell performance in ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ is yet to be seen,” McKellen concluded.

Stewart and McKellen’s friendship was one of the most beloved in the entertainment industry. The two became friends while playing Professor X and Magneto, respectively, in 2000’s “X-Men.” Looking back in a 2020 interview with Wired, Stewart said, “We had adjoining trailers. On those kind of movies, you spend more time sitting in your trailer than you do in front of the camera. So Ian and I hung out together, drinking tea — and maybe, in the afternoon, something a little stronger — and we got to know one another, and the charm of it was that we found we had so much in common.”

articles.title: Sir Patrick Stewart: Actor who moved effortlessly between Star Trek and Shakespeare
articles.summary: The English actor began his career on stage before finding fame as the captain of the USS Enterprise.
body: Sir Patrick Stewart, who has died at the age of 86, was a stage and screen great who balanced Hollywood stardom with an equally stellar career in classical theatre.
While many actors are typecast, he moved effortlessly from Shakespeare and Dickens to the command of the USS Enterprise and his famous wheelchair in X-Men.
In a career that spanned seven decades, Sir Patrick received multiple awards, a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame and a knighthood from Queen Elizabeth II.
One of the world's most versatile actors, he mastered both comedy and tragedy, science-fiction and historical drama - despite the entertainment industry's traditional dislike of bald heads.

articles.title: California Begins Discussion on Unlimited Film Incentives: ‘That Is a Heavy Lift’
articles.summary: California lawmakers began a discussion Thursday about removing the cap on the state’s $750 million incentive for film and TV production, while acknowledging that such a move would face budget hurdles.
body: Betsy Beers, the creative partner of Shonda Rhimes, told the committee that she had hoped to shoot a new “Grey’s Anatomy” spinoff in Santa Clarita. But the show, which is set in West Texas, did not get a California tax credit.
“We lost a lot of time, and a lot of money, and now we are filming in Albuquerque,” Beers said. “We want to be here.”

“The program is still not competitive or predicable enough to address the loss of production to other regions,” said Arlen Valdivia, vice president of state government affairs at the Motion Picture Association. “There needs to be more done to make California competitive.”

FilmLA, the permitting agency, reported last week that production volume continues to fall in the Los Angeles area, even as the share of scripted TV shows receiving a state subsidy has nearly doubled. Several speakers at Thursday’s hearing called for eliminating the $750 million cap entirely — saying the limit leaves producers uncertain about whether they will get the credit.

articles.title: Elke Sommer, prolific German star of A Shot in the Dark and And Then There Were None, dies aged 85
articles.summary: The Berlin-born performer had a gift for languages that took her to Hollywood, landing roles alongside Peter Sellers, Dick Van Dyke and Paul Newman. Elke Sommer, the prolific German star of the Pink Panther film A Shot in the Dark, early 70s Agatha Christie adaptation And Then there Were None, and…
body: German-born Sommer, whose best-known film roles were in the 1960s and 70s, was one of the wave of European performers who crossed over to Hollywood and English-language cinema with considerable success, following the postwar emergence of European new wave cinema. Sommer was one of the few German actors to make waves at the time, as Hollywood made much of her bombshell image.

Born Elke Schletz in 1940 in Berlin, the daughter of a Protestant pastor, she was evacuated with her family to Bavaria during the war. Intending to work as an interpreter, she was spotted by celebrated Italian director Vittorio De Sica after winning a beauty contest on a trip to Italy in 1958, and subsequently offered roles in a string of Italian comedy films. She crossed back into more serious work with the West German drama The Death Ship, opposite Horst Buchholz (who would go on to appear in cowboy classic The Magnificent Seven).

body: As with every war movie, there are a thousand possibly better or more challenging war movies existing at the margins of this one. But this one, firmly for the marines, is what we got. articles.title: Patrick Stewart’s Career Was a Rare and Thrilling Marriage of the Prestigious and the Populist
articles.summary: Stewart's classical theater chops invested genre film and television roles with unlikely dramatic weight, psychological depth and piercing feeling.
body: In the first two decades and change of Patrick Stewart’s distinguished professional career, he spent 16 years with the Royal Shakespeare Company, made his Broadway debut alongside Ben Kingsley and Frances de la Tour in a legendary production of A Midsummer Night’s Dream directed by influential theater giant Peter Brook, and became a frequent presence on the storied stages of the prestigious Royal National Theatre.

That wealth of stage experience was deeply embedded in his layered characterization as Captain Jean-Luc Picard, commander of the USS Enterprise, allowing Stewart to project steely authority without ever losing sight of the man’s kindness and compassion, his mentorship and familial protectiveness toward his crew.
points: Stewart's classical theater chops invested genre film and television roles with unlikely dramatic weight, psychological depth and piercing feeling.

articles.title: Patrick Stewart's Final Movie Roles Sum Up His Generational Talent
articles.summary: Patrick Stewart was a truly extraordinary actor, and his last few movie roles, while disparate, perfectly show off his versatility and skill as a performer.
body: A light has gone out of the universe, as Sir Patrick Stewart died on Wednesday, October 28. The legendary actor's final film role will be "Avengers: Doomsday," scheduled for release on December 18, 2026, where he will again play Professor Charles Xavier. It's a fitting denouement; Stewart played Professor X across many films for 26 years, and he remains the greatest casting for a comic book superhero in history.

Stewart's penultimate role was a voiceover part in the whimsical murder mystery "The Sheep Detectives" (now available to watch at home), where he indeed played one of the sheep as part of an all-star voice cast including Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, and Regina Hall. His "X-Men" co-star, Hugh Jackman, plays the flock's shepherd and the murder victim at the center of the film's mystery. Stewart's character, Sir Ritchfield, is one of the oldest and most conservative sheep in the flock. If these last two roles don't sum up how eclectic Patrick Stewart's acting career was, nothing does.
points: Patrick Stewart was a truly extraordinary actor, and his last few movie roles, while disparate, perfectly show off his versatility and skill as a performer.

articles.title: Curry Barker Returns to His YouTube Horror Roots With ‘Mama Bear’ Amid ‘Obsession’ Success
articles.summary: The filmmaker's five-minute short reunited him with 'Obsession' costume designer Blair James, who tells The Hollywood Reporter the project was filmed just three and a half weeks before its release.
body: Curry Barker is returning to his YouTube roots with Mama Bear, a new horror short the Obsession filmmaker released Thursday, just in time for Halloween.
The cast also includes Katie Sarife as Lacey, Ericka Kreuz as Ms. Wilson and Joshua Snyder as Floyd’s doppelgänger.
Sarife will also appear in Medium Rare, an upcoming horror short from Barker’s father, Jeff Barker, which The Hollywood Reporter exclusively reported was in the works.

The short’s eerie atmosphere and unsettling visuals echo Obsession, particularly a shot of a figure lurking in a dark corner. The moment recalls a scene in the feature film in which Nikki (Inde Navarrette) watches Bear (Michael Johnston) sleep from a similarly shadowy corner.
